text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when I was wandering outside 
aimlessly for a change of pace――

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ――Oh dear, whatever should I do?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth――I've been asked to help 
with a performance for a local community 
event.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The plan is for everyone to listen to a 
children's choir. Since it's a special 
occasion, I really wanted to make it 
wonderful, but――

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
However――many of the children are quite 
shy, you see...
choice_data_list: That's a bit of a shame.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it is――I am sure all the visitors 
are looking forward to hearing their 
singing, but...
choice_data_list:
...Do you mind if I come watch the 
practice too?

...Do you mind if I come watch the 
practice too?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
...tchi... pitchi, chappu... yappu, ran... 
an...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the number of children present, their 
voices were very small. It seemed the 
entire group was hesitating to sing out 
loud, influenced by the few who held back 
nervously.

text_block_list.name: Shy Child
text_block_list.text:
B-Big sister... Singing really is 
embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It will be alright――everyone is right 
beside you. Would you like to try it 
little by little――even just one phrase at 
a time?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Karen Bouquetd'or gently encouraged them. 
However, her efforts didn't quite bear 
fruit. Even with a gentle push, what felt 
scary was still scary to them.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If only they could feel――that singing is 
fun, that would be for the best, but...

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Forcing frightened children will 
only――disrupt their inner harmony even 
further. To keep that from happening――
choice_data_list: Then let me set an example!
Then let me set an example!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Shy Child
text_block_list.text:
B-Bitchi-bitchi...? Isn't it 
pitchi-pitchi...?
choice_data_list:
I messed up! But 'bitchi-bitchi' has 
plenty of energy, right?

text_block_list.name: Shy Child
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha! I-I guess so, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Watching Child
text_block_list.text:
That's so weird! They got it wrong, but 
they look like they're having so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. It will be lots of fun――if you 
all sing along too. Even if you make a 
mistake――I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Shy Child
text_block_list.text:
Really...? Just like mister over there... 
me too...?

text_block_list.name: Shy Child
text_block_list.text:
Really...? Just like miss over there... me 
too...?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: ――A~me~ a~me~ fu~re~ fu~re♪ Ka~a-san ga~♪

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
――...Such wonderful harmony. I can truly 
feel everyone's joy.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
――Ah. Perhaps during the actual event, 
too――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the community event. Invited 
enthusiastically by Karen Bouquetd'or, I 
headed over to the venue――

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, . Did you come to cheer on 
Bouquet-chan too?♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, . Did you come to cheer on 
Bouquet-chan too?♪

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Bouquet-san has been preparing for 
today all this time, so... I really hope 
it goes well for her.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely gonna be a massive 
success♪ Hard work and miles never betray 
you!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, they're coming out! Bouquet-san 
and the kids!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Before――we present our song... There is a 
favor I would like to ask of the audience.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The song we will sing today――is one that 
is very familiar to all of you.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Would you please join us――and sing along 
with these children?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
――With your help, I know these children 
will be able to shine even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Puzzled Woman
text_block_list.text: Huh...? We're... singing too?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Sounds awesome, sign me up! I'm gonna sing 
at 120 miles per hour!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: My, then I'll give it 120% love♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: A~me~ a~me~ fu~re~ fu~re♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ka~a-san ga~♪

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Pi... Pitchi pitchi, chappu chappu♪

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Ran ran ran♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Little by little, the chorus of voices 
grew louder――forming a circle of harmony 
that enveloped the entire venue.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ka~ke~ma~sho ka~ba~n wo~♪ Ka~a-sa~n no~♪

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ――Ah.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
What a lovely melody―― Everyone's voices, 
their feelings overlapping――becoming one.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: That was so much fun! Encore~!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Encore! Encore!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ――! We would be delighted to.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If you would be so kind――please sing along 
with us once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so――the second chorus echoed brightly 
and splendidly beneath the open sky.
